Corpus › Testing › bỏ_qua

bỏ_qua

Translation status: Tiếng Việt reader-locale proof. Term names and code fences follow the vi pack; supporting prose may still be English.

Marks a test case as skipped with a reason.

Aliases: skip

Syntax: kiểm_thử <name> bỏ_qua <reason> <block>

Category#

testing

Related#

  • kiểm_thử
  • việc_cần_làm

Examples#

radix/corpus/omitte/omitte.fab (canonical · keyword)#

Marks a test case as skipped with a reason.

# =============================================================================
# bỏ_qua — Marks a test case as skipped with a reason.
# =============================================================================
#
# What this teaches:
#   • Test skipping — `bỏ_qua` marks a test case to be skipped, with a required reason string.
#   • Test modifiers — Tests can be modified with `bỏ_qua` to temporarily disable them.
#
# Common mistakes:
#   • Confusing bỏ_qua (test skip) with im_lặng (no-op) — bỏ_qua marks a test as skipped, im_lặng is an empty statement.
#
# See also: kiểm_thử, việc_cần_làm
# =============================================================================

# bỏ_qua — skipped test modifier
#
# GRAMMAR:
#   testModifier :← 'bỏ_qua' stringLit
#
# EXPECTED OUTPUT:
#   No bắt_đầu — declaration or test-runner surface only.
#
# BACKEND:
#   declaration-only test modifier (whitelist: bỏ_qua/omitte.fab).
#

test "database connection" skip "blocked" {
    assert false
}
